|translation='''Title:''' Bewilderment.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on a Jedi character. Unless a Dark Jedi is at the same location, the opponent's total ability at that location is reduced by 2.

'''Lore:''' “What was that?” One of the Jedi powers, “bewilderment,” is a technique that distracts opponents and draws them away, avoiding unnecessary battles.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says a Jedi character, without the English restriction “one of your Jedi.” It checks whether a Dark Jedi is at the same location; the English uses “also present.”<ref name="photo">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Affect-Mind-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref><ref name="english-printing">[[:File:Premiere-L-affectmind-decipher-archive.gif|Affect Mind English printed face]].</ref>
